mapper.select:
select b.id, b.name, b.phone, b.gender, b.age, b.wechat, b.qq, b.subject, b.course_id, b.degree, b.job_status, b.channel, b.remark, b.status, b.user_id, b.clue_id, b.next_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, u.name as assignName from business b left join user u on b.user_id = u.id
and b.id = #{businessQueryDTO.businessId}
and b.name like concat('%', #{businessQueryDTO.name}, '%')
and b.phone like concat('%', #{businessQueryDTO.phone}, '%')
and b.status = #{businessQueryDTO.status}
and u.name like concat('%', #{businessQueryDTO.assignName}, '%')
order by b.create_time desc
